revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Missing Parentheses?
revealWordProblem.text:
Akela's math teacher gives him a challenge: see how many different values the expression on the board can have, depending on where one set of parentheses is placed. The expression is 48 ÷ 2³ × ½ + 1.7.
Question: How many different values can you come up with? Show the placement that gives each value.
revealWordProblem.imageAlt: A chalkboard showing the expression 48 divided by 2 cubed, times one-half, plus 1.7.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Evaluate the original first, following the order of operations: 2³ = 8, then 48 ÷ 8 = 6, then 6 × ½ = 3, then 3 + 1.7 = 4.7. Now try one set of parentheses in each sensible place and evaluate again — for example (48 ÷ 2³) × ½ + 1.7 = 4.7 (no change, because that is already the order), 48 ÷ (2³ × ½) + 1.7 = 48 ÷ 4 + 1.7 = 13.7, and 48 ÷ 2³ × (½ + 1.7) = 6 × 2.2 = 13.2. Each placement that changes which operation happens first gives a new value; a placement that only repeats the existing order gives 4.7 again. Record every distinct result and count them.

choiceFeedback: That adds first: (3 + 4) × 2. Multiplication comes first.
hints: Which operation comes first in the order of operations?
Do 4 × 2 before touching the 3.
questions.explanationEs: La multiplicación va antes que la suma: 4 × 2 = 8, luego 3 + 8 = 11.
hintsEs: ¿Cuál operación va primero en el orden de las operaciones?
Haz 4 × 2 antes de tocar el 3.

questions.explanation: The exponent says how many times the base is used as a factor, so 2³ = 2 × 2 × 2 = 8.
choiceFeedback: That multiplies the base by the exponent — a common mix-up.
An exponent means repeated multiplication, not repeated addition.
That uses the exponent as the base.
hints: Which number is the base, and which is the exponent?
The exponent counts how many 2s are multiplied.
Write out the repeated multiplication the exponent asks for, then compare it with the choices.
questions.explanationEs: El exponente dice cuántas veces se usa la base como factor, así que 2³ = 2 × 2 × 2 = 8.
hintsEs: ¿Cuál número es la base y cuál es el exponente?
El exponente cuenta cuántos 2 se multiplican.
Escribe la multiplicación repetida que pide el exponente y luego compárala con las opciones.

questions.stem: Sofia buys 4 tickets at $20 each and 2 tickets at $15 each. Which expression shows the total?
questions.explanation: Each ticket type is a count times a price, and the two costs are added: 4 × 20 + 2 × 15.
choiceFeedback: Adding the counts to the prices loses the meaning of "each".
That multiplies total tickets by total prices, which is not what was bought.
That pairs the counts with each other and the prices with each other.
hints: What does "each" tell you to do?
Write one product per ticket type.
Then join the two costs with addition.
questions.stemEs: Sofía compra 4 boletos a $20 cada uno y 2 boletos a $15 cada uno. ¿Cuál expresión muestra el total?
questions.explanationEs: Cada tipo de boleto es una cantidad por un precio, y los dos costos se suman: 4 × 20 + 2 × 15.
hintsEs: ¿Qué te indica hacer la palabra "cada"?
Escribe un producto por cada tipo de boleto.
Luego une los dos costos con una suma.

steps: 1. Grouping Symbols: Parentheses, brackets, fraction bars inner to outer
3. Multiply & Divide left to right; Add & Subtract left to right
reviewHighlights.watchOut: A common mistake with powers is multiplying the base by the exponent: reading 3² as 3 × 2 = 6 instead of 3 × 3 = 9. A second is evaluating strictly left to right, so 3 + 4 × 2 becomes 14 instead of 11. The order of operations exists so one expression has exactly one value: grouping symbols, then powers, then × and ÷ left to right, then + and − left to right.

hints: Find 4² first. Then multiply. Add last.
hintsEs: Primero halla 4². Luego multiplica. Suma al final.

level1.stem: There are 5 boxes with 2³ apples in each box. 6 apples are bad. Evaluate 5 × 2³ − 6 to find the good apples.
level1.stemEs: Hay 5 cajas con 2³ manzanas en cada caja. 6 manzanas están malas. Evalúa 5 × 2³ − 6 para hallar las manzanas buenas.
hints: Find 2³ first. Then multiply by 5. Subtract last.
hintsEs: Primero halla 2³. Luego multiplica por 5. Resta al final.

hints: Power first, then multiply. Then add and subtract from left to right.
hintsEs: Primero la potencia, luego multiplica. Después suma y resta de izquierda a derecha.
level1.explanation: Find the power. Multiply: 20 − 9 + 8 Subtract and add, left to right: 20 − 9 + 8 = 11 + 8 = 19
level1.explanationEs: Halla la potencia. Multiplica: 20 − 9 + 8 Resta y suma, de izquierda a derecha: 20 − 9 + 8 = 11 + 8 = 19

hints: Find the power first. Then multiply. Add last.
hintsEs: Primero halla la potencia. Luego multiplica. Suma al final.

hints: Find 2³ first. Then do each multiplication. Add last.
hintsEs: Primero halla 2³. Luego haz cada multiplicación. Suma al final.
level1.explanation: Find the power: 2³ = 8 Multiply, left to right: 75 + 40 + 24 Add: 75 + 40 + 24 = 139
level1.explanationEs: Halla la potencia: 2³ = 8 Multiplica, de izquierda a derecha: 75 + 40 + 24 Suma: 75 + 40 + 24 = 139

level2.stem: Kim evaluates 3 + 4 × 5². She adds 3 + 4 first and gets 175. Is she right? Find the correct value.
level2.stemEs: Kim evalúa 3 + 4 × 5². Primero suma 3 + 4 y obtiene 175. ¿Tiene razón? Halla el valor correcto.
hints: Add comes last. What must you do before you add?
hintsEs: La suma va al final. ¿Qué debes hacer antes de sumar?
level2.explanation: Find the power first: 5² = 25 Multiply: 4 × 25 = 100 Add last: 3 + 100 = 103
level2.explanationEs: Primero halla la potencia: 5² = 25 Multiplica: 4 × 25 = 100 Suma al final: 3 + 100 = 103

hints: Find 3³ first. Then multiply and divide from left to right. Subtract last.
hintsEs: Primero halla 3³. Luego multiplica y divide de izquierda a derecha. Resta al final.
level2.explanation: Find the power: 3³ = 27 Multiply and divide, left to right: 2 × 27 ÷ 6 = 54 ÷ 6 = 9 Subtract: 50 − 9 = 41
level2.explanationEs: Halla la potencia: 3³ = 27 Multiplica y divide, de izquierda a derecha: 2 × 27 ÷ 6 = 54 ÷ 6 = 9 Resta: 50 − 9 = 41

hints: Power first, then multiply, then add.
hintsEs: Primero la potencia, luego multiplica y luego suma.

level2.stem: A number is squared. The result is multiplied by 2. Then 5 is added. The final value is 37. What is the number?
level2.stemEs: Un número se eleva al cuadrado. El resultado se multiplica por 2. Luego se suma 5. El valor final es 37. ¿Cuál es el número?
hints: Work backward. Undo the last step first: subtract 5.
hintsEs: Trabaja hacia atrás. Primero deshaz el último paso: resta 5.
level2.explanation: Undo the addition: 37 − 5 = 32 Undo the multiplication: 32 ÷ 2 = 16 Find the number whose square is 16: 4² = 16
level2.explanationEs: Deshaz la suma: 37 − 5 = 32 Deshaz la multiplicación: 32 ÷ 2 = 16 Halla el número cuyo cuadrado es 16: 4² = 16

level2.stem: A garden has 2 square beds. Each bed is 6 feet long on each side, so its area is 6² square feet. A path covers 10 square feet. What is the total area?
level2.stemEs: Un jardín tiene 2 canteros cuadrados. Cada cantero mide 6 pies en cada lado, así que su área es 6² pies cuadrados. Un camino cubre 10 pies cuadrados. ¿Cuál es el área total?
hints: Write 2 × 6² + 10. Find the power first.
hintsEs: Escribe 2 × 6² + 10. Primero halla la potencia.
level2.explanation: Write the expression: 2 × 6² + 10 Find the power. Then multiply: 2 × 36 = 72 Add: 72 + 10 = 82
level2.explanationEs: Escribe la expresión: 2 × 6² + 10 Halla la potencia. Luego multiplica: 2 × 36 = 72 Suma: 72 + 10 = 82

choiceFeedback: Only the power was evaluated. Continue: multiply by 3, then subtract 8.
The exponent was treated as a multiplier, 4 times 2. Four squared is 16.
The multiplication happened before the power. Powers come first: evaluate 4 squared, then multiply.
level3.explanation: Following the order of operations, evaluate the power first: 4² = 16. Then multiply: 3 × 16 = 48. Then subtract: 48 − 8 = 40.

level3.stem: Jay says 4 × 3² is 144, because 4 × 3 = 12 and 12² = 144. Find the correct value of 4 × 3².
level3.stemEs: Jay dice que 4 × 3² es 144, porque 4 × 3 = 12 y 12² = 144. Halla el valor correcto de 4 × 3².
hints: The exponent belongs only to the 3. Find 3² before you multiply.
hintsEs: El exponente le pertenece solo al 3. Halla 3² antes de multiplicar.

hints: Work inside the parentheses first. That includes the power 2³.
hintsEs: Primero trabaja dentro de los paréntesis. Eso incluye la potencia 2³.
level3.explanation: Work inside the parentheses: 18 − 8 = 10 Find the other power. Multiply: 10 × 3 + 16 = 30 + 16 Add: 30 + 16 = 46
level3.explanationEs: Trabaja dentro de los paréntesis: 18 − 8 = 10 Halla la otra potencia. Multiplica: 10 × 3 + 16 = 30 + 16 Suma: 30 + 16 = 46

level3.stem: A phone plan costs $30 a month, plus $2 for each GB used over 2³ GB. Tom uses 12 GB. Write and evaluate an expression for his bill.
level3.stemEs: Un plan de teléfono cuesta $30 al mes, más $2 por cada GB que se use después de 2³ GB. Tom usa 12 GB. Escribe y evalúa una expresión para su factura.
hints: First find how many GB are over 2³. Use parentheses: 30 + 2 × (12 − 2³).
hintsEs: Primero halla cuántos GB pasan de 2³. Usa paréntesis: 30 + 2 × (12 − 2³).
level3.explanation: Write the expression: 30 + 2 × (12 − 2³) Work inside the parentheses: 12 − 8 = 4 Multiply, then add: 30 + 2 × 4 = 38
level3.explanationEs: Escribe la expresión: 30 + 2 × (12 − 2³) Trabaja dentro de los paréntesis: 12 − 8 = 4 Multiplica y luego suma: 30 + 2 × 4 = 38

level3.stem: Put one set of parentheses in 36 ÷ 3² + 3 × 2 so the value is 14. Which placement works?
level3.stemEs: Pon un par de paréntesis en 36 ÷ 3² + 3 × 2 para que el valor sea 14. ¿Qué lugar funciona?
hints: Test each placement. Always work inside the parentheses first, then follow the order of operations.
hintsEs: Prueba cada lugar. Siempre trabaja primero dentro de los paréntesis y luego sigue el orden de las operaciones.
level3.explanation: Work inside the parentheses: 36 ÷ 9 + 3 = 4 + 3 = 7 Multiply by 2: 7 × 2 = 14
level3.explanationEs: Trabaja dentro de los paréntesis: 36 ÷ 9 + 3 = 4 + 3 = 7 Multiplica por 2: 7 × 2 = 14
choiceFeedback: These parentheses do not change the order. The value is 4 + 6 = 10.
